paragraphs: Mentioned in Sanhedrin 29a: Rav Ashi said, “Natan bar Mar Zutra told me: False witnesses are despised even by those who hire them.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: כט. gives Sanhedrin 29a under the period convention without fresh named-edition verification. Full Mar is supplied twice and full Rav before Ashi; Natan has no separate personal title.

אאוגרייהו זילי concerns false witnesses being despised by their hirers, not cheap wages. The direction is Natan telling Rav Ashi; even is a contextual idiomatic clarification of their contempt, not an extra Hebrew word.
